name: Kajiki Yuuki
source:
The Unrewarded Hard Worker and Clumsy Girl.

Ayunosu Academy, 1st Year Class G. Academically top-tier within the school. However, she's inept at most things outside of studying.

A shy, absent-minded, clumsy girl. Always earnest and plucky, an unrewarded hard worker.

She also possesses a devilish side due to her airheaded nature.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
